d: While US President Donald Trump has been busy with the campaign trail ahead of the November 3 US Midterm Election, Xi Jinping decided to send Trump a reminder about China. In the last week of October, China carried out a 'No-Notice' launch of the DF-26 ballistic missile. Additionally, there are reports that China also fired the DF-26B anti-ship missile recently. However, some reports suggest the missile was not tested. However, the 'No-Notice' launch of the DF-26 has been confirmed. The DF-26 is known as 'Guam Express' or the 'Guam Killer' because it can strike the US military bases…
